tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Primary. Sampled from the master logo's lettering. Primary buttons, header bar, links on white. White text on it reads at 4.9:1. Not for small text on mist (4.1:1): use link there.

tokens.name: sunset-orange
tokens.usage: Primary. Sampled from the master logo's sun. Accent only, about a tenth of any page: the stripe motif, highlights, 'from' prices in large type, icon accents. Text on it is night-navy (5.9:1), never white (2.6:1).

tokens.name: night-navy
tokens.usage: Primary. Body text and headings on mist and white (12.9:1 on mist), footer and dark bands, text on sunset-orange and whatsapp. Sunset-orange text reads on it at 5.9:1.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Primary. A very light sea-mist tint. Page background and alternating sections; `white` sections and cards sit on it. Replaced the earlier sand, which read as dated. In print, use white paper.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on mist: cards, forms, timetable tables. Text colour on brand-blue, terracotta and macchia-green.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text colour on mist and white.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on mist (6.4:1) and white.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and blue text on mist (5.7:1) and white. A deeper step of brand-blue for text only.

tokens.name: emerald-sea
tokens.usage: Secondary. The north-east coast's water. Route lines, map overlays, line badges, info icons. Not for text: 2.8:1 on white.

tokens.name: emerald-sea-text
tokens.usage: Emerald text on mist (5.1:1) and white (6.0:1), e.g. route names and info labels.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Secondary. Rooftops and Alghero coral. Service alerts and disruption notices, always with an icon and a word. White text on it 5.4:1; as text on mist 4.6:1.

tokens.name: macchia-green
tokens.usage: Secondary. The myrtle and lentisk scrub. Confirmations and nature-tour accents, always with an icon or a word. White text on it 6.2:1; as text on mist 5.1:1.

tokens.name: granite
tokens.usage: Secondary. A cool granite grey. Borders, input outlines, inactive icons (3.3:1 on mist, enough for marks, not for text).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card edges where no meaning is carried.

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: WhatsApp buttons and links only, so the channel stays recognisable. Label in night-navy (7.7:1), never white.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid outline with 2px offset on every interactive element, on mist, white and blue alike.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices and big numbers in offers and service cards.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows above headings, line badges. The only style set in capitals.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Da oltre 60 anni colleghiamo Olbia, la Gallura e il nord della Sardegna.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Prenota online o scrivici su WhatsApp.

styles.name: timetable
styles.usage: Times and fares. Turn on tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) so columns align.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and the mobile contact bar.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card and button padding, mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between cards, form groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: stripe-height
tokens.usage: Height of one band in the sun-stripe motif at web scale.

tokens.name: stripe-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between bands in the sun-stripe motif; the ground shows through.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, timetable cells, line badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, photos.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The sun disc, pills, the WhatsApp button, avatar crops.
